meta.title: Product Roadmap — KB Labs
meta.description: What we're building and when — quarterly development plan.

items.title: Go Tooling Stabilization
items.description: kb-devkit, kb-dev, kb-deploy, kb-monitor — stable releases with cross-platform binaries and install scripts.

items.title: E2E Testing on Critical Paths
items.description: End-to-end coverage for installation, service startup, and core product workflows.

items.title: Demo Scenario
items.description: kb-create --demo: install the platform and see the full cycle (commit plugin + gateway) working on your own codebase.

items.title: Public Launch on GitHub
items.description: Open-source monorepo, npm packages (core/sdk/shared under MIT), GitHub Releases with binaries.

items.title: REST API v1
items.description: OpenAPI-documented platform API with authentication and rate limiting.

items.title: Documentation
items.description: 90+ pages of docs covering architecture, SDK, guides, and operations.

items.title: Utility Plugin Pack
items.description: A set of broadly useful plugins: notifications, scheduling, environment management, and more.

items.title: Plugin SDK Stabilization
items.description: Stable plugin API, versioned contracts, comprehensive SDK documentation and examples.

items.title: Community Adapters
items.description: Extension points are open today — anyone can write a Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or any HTTP adapter.

items.title: Studio v1.0
items.description: Web UI for workflow monitoring, execution history, and plugin management.

items.title: Notification Contract
items.description: Unified notification interface — plugins send notifications, adapters deliver them (Slack, Telegram, email, webhooks).

items.title: RBAC — Role-Based Access Control
items.description: Permission system for platform resources: who can run what, access which services, and manage which plugins.

items.title: Mind RAG v2
items.description: Multi-repo search, improved anti-hallucination, and cross-project intelligence.

items.title: Workflow Templates
items.description: Pre-built workflow templates for common automation patterns: CI, releases, code review, onboarding.

items.title: KB Labs Registry
items.description: Own package registry for plugins and adapters — publish, version, and distribute without npm.

items.title: Marketplace v2
items.description: Full marketplace experience: discover, install, rate, and review plugins from the registry.

items.title: Plugin Verification
items.description: Automated security and compatibility checks for published plugins.

items.title: ABAC — Attribute-Based Access Control
items.description: Fine-grained permissions beyond roles: conditions based on resource attributes, time, environment.

items.title: Hosted Platform
items.description: Managed KB Labs — same platform, zero ops. For teams that want the product without running infrastructure.

items.title: Multi-Tenant Production
items.description: Isolated tenants, resource quotas, and org-level administration.

items.title: Enterprise Integrations
items.description: SSO (SAML/OIDC), audit log export, and compliance tooling — driven by customer needs.

items.title: Agent Marketplace
items.description: Pre-built AI agents with governed execution — install, configure, and run from the marketplace.

cta.description: Share your use case and help us prioritize what matters to your team.
